remaining_material_centroid.reasoning: The outer rectangle and every cutout are invariant under reflection about x=60 and y=40, so their area-weighted remainder centroid is the intersection (60,40).

minimum_cutout_to_boundary_clearance.derivation: Each hole center is 10 mm from its nearest outer edge and has radius 3 mm; the slot is farther from every edge.

symmetry_reasoning: The four corner holes occur in reflected pairs and the centered slot preserves both plate reflection axes. Removing these symmetric cutouts from the symmetric outer rectangle leaves the centroid at (60,40) mm.
